name: Column Grid Slider
description: Image slider that opens with a counter preloader and a zoomed-out grid of moving columns. Entering the flow expands one image full-screen with split-character titles, captions and a thumbnail strip, then scrolls on with Lenis.
contents: Full-screen expanded image with caption, category, two-part title and paragraph
Scroll spacer and footer with contact prompt and email link
behavior: Counter runs to 100 then reveals the column grid with a stagger
Clicking enter slides columns up and down, expands the leftmost image to full width
Title and paragraph animate in character by character on each slide change
After entering, page scrolls smoothly with Lenis while the hero image scales and fades
Thumbnails swap the active slide with a crossfade
editableByProps: Slides: images, titles, captions, categories, paragraphs
Which slides appear in each grid column
Colors, font family, title size, grid item size
Enter button label and background, preloader duration, footer text and email

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the number of grid columns animating up or down
needsCodeEdit.where: columnImages.map block with the isUp check

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the scroll length after entering

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis after entering, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Sets body overflow to auto after entering and restores it on unmount
Uses fixed positioned layers that cover the viewport, so it should be the main content of the page
Includes a 200vh scroll spacer and a 50vh footer needed for the scroll range
Title and paragraph are split into characters through DOM writes at each slide change
